decision: Conditional feasibility only; no source implementation or GPU experiment approved while WAIT2 result and exact plan remain unresolved
mechanism: Replace64 producer threads with one full128-thread producer warpgroup, retaining512 compute threads, one CTA per SM, original tiles, work ranges, packing, shared-memory rings and mathematical operations; redistribute the CTA register allocation with setmaxnreg
primary_contract: PTX adjustments use a CTA-local register pool. inc blocks until its requested registers are available; the extra register contents must be initialized.

All warps in a warpgroup must execute the same instruction. Successive setmaxnreg instructions require explicit warpgroup synchronization. Quotas are multiples of8 in24..256, with direction consistent with currently owned quota.
An appropriate launch/compiler register specification is required or the hint may have no effect. Arithmetic feasibility alone does not establish honored dynamic quotas.

Warps16/17 keep weight/X producer work; warps18/19 perform no tensor or routing work. If barrier2 expands with NTL to640, both idle warps must arrive exactly once before returning. Author selected this widened-join design.

No consumer-dependent barrier may precede producer decrease if consumer increment can block waiting for those released registers. With exactly8192 returned/requested, availability follows once the producer warpgroup decreases; it must remain schedulable independently of consumer progress.
Do not add a640-thread barrier after any producer or idle thread has returned. Preserve producer joins, final wait0, grid-barrier admission, scratch lifetime and final PDL trigger semantics.
Newly acquired registers cannot carry meaningful pre-increment values. Preserve source operation order and require compiler evidence that register accesses obey each region's quota.

go_no_go_conditions: Wait for exact WAIT2 compiler/resource/per-case results. Additional register capacity is a mechanism hypothesis only if there is evidence it addresses a real limiting resource; a legal quota does not imply useful overlap.

Require one chosen quota/role layout, exact source and fallback conformance, barrier-participant proof, initial-pool and actual occupancy checks for both specializations, and no automatic tuning sweep.

If actual allocation cannot support the chosen quotas, or setmaxnreg emission cannot be established sufficiently to interpret the experiment, stop or explicitly report the mechanism unresolved; do not claim dynamic headroom from65536 arithmetic.
Even an admitted kernel may spill at producer32, serialize WGMMA, increase instruction cost or regress. Only official numerical/performance evidence can decide whether the architecture is useful.
